format: NDJSON: one JSON object per line, the stored segment lines verbatim, in chain order
hash_rule: entry.hash = SHA-256(entry.prev as UTF-8 || canonical(entry.content)); canonical = JSON with sorted keys and separators (",", ":"); the first entry's prev is "GENESIS"
pair_rule: a receipt pair is two consecutive entries sharing content.pair_id (index_in_pair 0 then 1); the second member's content.pair_anchor equals the first member's entry hash

paging.note: the complete export is the concatenation of the windows in offset order; paging is a transport fetch strategy for legs that truncate large single responses -- the recompute over the assembled stream is the verification

served: live read of the production receipts at request time (read-only); the export can never drift from the chain it exports
